title: Include planning records in canonical exports
description: Extend canonical export and legacy --export-tasks to include a managed planning directory containing UUID-named planning JSON records while executable task files remain at the export root. Snapshot executable tasks, planning items, handoffs, and reusable definitions consistently under the global lock. Treat planning as a managed directory, enforce its exact expected contents, remove stale managed planning records safely, and continue rejecting symlinks, unmanaged entries, and paths overlapping active storage. Preserve deterministic bytes/order, empty planning directory behavior, idempotence, and existing executable export compatibility. Add Unix/Windows tests for empty/populated stores, all planning statuses, shared IDs, reusable assignments, live renames, stale cleanup, and injected failures.
